name: Universal Arts Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, Universal Arts Ltd is in 
the business of buying and selling movies 
rights.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UAL is engaged in the business of trading
film rights. It does the production of TV serials, 
feature films, trading in film rights, television 
software, etc. The company is a pioneer
 in acquiring negative rights (i.e., absolute 
rights) of films for a period of 99 years.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.68 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -71.7% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.40% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 7,519 days to 12,775 days
